title: M9-C42.25 / M25.3 — financial_intelligence Forensic Inventory
methodology: Complete source inspection (all 8 modules read line-by-line) + coverage.py missing-line analysis (29.9% at entry, 807 statements — historical 807-statement figure VERIFIED against current repo) + grep-based caller mapping. Performed independently of the transaction inventory.
architecture: Pure-function intelligence layer: forecasting, goal planning, optimization, scenario simulation, and report aggregation. No database access, no LLM calls. Monetary values: integer paise; ratios: Decimal; rates: basis points.

decision_logic: trend: first-half vs second-half average, 10% relative threshold, zero-baseline handling
variance<2 elements -> 0.0
weighted average weight-length validation -> ValueError
confidence inverse-variance normalization bounded [0,1]

uncovered_regions.region: next_month December rollover already indirectly covered

decision_logic: forecast_cashflow: forecast_months clamp [1,12]; empty history -> zero forecast + neutral 0.5 confidence from 2026-01; sorted history; explicit surplus_paise vs computed income-expense; weighted moving average; variance-derived confidence
forecast_liquidity: empty forecast -> risk from current liquidity vs threshold; risk matrix low/medium/high from projected_min, stress month <=1/>=2/<=3/beyond
forecast_credit_utilization: dependency from credit_history avg else financial-event fallback; worsening +10% (capped 1.0, gated on >0.1 current), improving -10% (floored 0.0), stable passthrough

_compute_current_credit_dependency: history first; events (cash_advance/credit_card_cash_advance/liability_increase with positive liability_change) ratio capped 1.0; revolver behavior default 0.3 vs 0.1; total_expense==0 -> 0
detect_future_cash_shortfall: stress month 1 -> critical; <=2 -> critical; else warning; negative-surplus+high-risk -> warning; else none

uncovered_regions.note: property tests only exercise credit_history path
property tests assert membership only, not branch correctness

decision_logic: goal projection: already-achieved fast paths, no-forecast zero confidence, positive-surplus-only allocation int(surplus*ratio), cumulative horizon scan, confidence extraction from first forecast with valid 'confidence' key
emergency target: non-positive expenses -> 0 target; expenses*months

debt payoff: combined loan+card list filtered outstanding>0, avalanche ordering by interest_rate_bps desc, allocation int(surplus*ratio), ceiling-division months, simplified interest estimate with 300bps fallback, None months when allocation==0

goal health: invalid target, months==0 achieved, months==None progress bands (0.75/0.50), target-date month comparison on_track/at_risk(<=3)/behind(>3), malformed-date fallback, no-target-date progress bands (0.5/0.25)
household summary: completed/on_track/at_risk counts, critical active goals list, projections shorter than goals

priorities: optimization actions ranked first with reason map (revolver>0.5 branch), emergency fund injection when liquidity months <3 (impact high when <1) with dedup + rank<=3 gate, credit dependency injection when revolver>0.5, sorted, capped at 5
confidence: 4 equal-weight factors (months/3 capped, completeness clamped, coverage clamped, inverse variance), quality bands excellent>=0.8 good>=0.6 fair>=0.4 else poor
report: full composition of snapshot+priorities+risks+opportunities+health+confidence with defaults (transaction_completeness 0.8, account_coverage 0.9)
risks: liquidity high->critical / medium->warning, credit trend worsening or dependency>0.3 (Decimal-typed check), debt_cycle_score>70, optimization warnings passthrough
opportunities: surplus>500000 -> investment (benefit 12x), active emergency_fund goal with remaining>0 and surplus>0 -> proximity
health: wellness_score passthrough if present else 0.4*(1-debt_cycle/100)+0.4*(1-revolver)+0.2*stability scaled to 100, clamped

uncovered_regions.note: genuinely untested; only statement_orchestrator touches report path marginally

decision_logic: derive_cash_advance_debt_entry: effective annual bps = fee/principal*10000*365/max(days,1); explicit outstanding_paise override (incl. 0 = settled); liability/expense zero -> 0 bps

surplus allocation cascade: emergency deficit first, high-interest debt 60% of remaining, medium-interest 60%, long-term active non-emergency goals 40%, remainder investment; non-positive surplus -> empty

debt strategy: invalid strategy -> avalanche fallback; active-balance filter with outstanding_paise||balance_paise fallback; avalanche (rate desc), snowball (balance asc), balanced (0.7*rate/5000 + 0.3*100000/max(balance,1000))
goal prioritization: emergency_fund < debt_payoff < deadline < other, user priority ascending; recommendations from emergency deficit and high-interest debt

action scoring: 4 factors with ACTION_WEIGHTS (interest 0.35, risk 0.30, urgency 0.20, goal 0.15); rate bands >=1800/>=800 bps; revolver bands >0.5/>0.2; impact bands >=0.7 high / >=0.4 medium; invalid action -> zero score; score quantized 0.01

plan orchestration: empty state -> warning; emergency status from forecast threshold−liquidity; action scores filtered >=0.5; warnings (emergency deficit, high-interest debt, no surplus); confidence from forecast.confidence else 0.7 if surplus>0 else 0
expense reduction: savings passthrough, cumulative benefit over generated 2026-08+ month sequence, base surplus beyond forecast horizon -> 0
income change: cumulative = change * months, revised surplus = base + change (negative allowed)
debt prepayment: baseline vs revised payoff projection via goal_planner; months_saved max(0, diff); avg_rate fallback 300; annual interest = total*int(rate/100)//100, monthly//12*months_saved
new loan: reuses loan_engine.emi.compute_emi_fixed (cross-module dependency); FOIR = emi/surplus, zero surplus -> 1.0; affordability safe<0.40 / warning<=0.60 / unsafe
credit behaviour: revolver==0 -> unchanged; no rate -> requires_rate_input=True with None savings; improvement factor = 1 - revolver*0.8
compare_scenario: COMPARE_METRICS loop, None skip, Decimal->float coercion, surplus/benefit/interest improvements, foir risk branch

anomalies.description: Condition `float(FOIR_WARNING_THRESHOLD) < scenario_val <= float(FOIR_WARNING_THRESHOLD)` is mathematically impossible (always False), so a negative foir change ALWAYS appends 'FOIR increased above safe threshold' even though the change is a decrease. The 'pass # warning zone' comment indicates suppressed intent, but whether the risk should be gated on the new value exceeding a threshold cannot be determined from code alone.
anomalies.disposition: AMBIGUOUS -> explicitly recorded, NOT silently assigned. Tests pin current behavior with an explicit anomaly note; no production change in C42.25.
